Three separate details decide the message. How you compare: reflect.DeepEqual says a nil slice and an empty one differ, and slices.Equal says they don't. How you print: %v makes "b " look like "b". Where you stop: the first mismatch is the useful one, so return as soon as you find it.

If slices.Equal(got, want), return "". If the lengths differ, return fmt.Sprintf("got %d elements, want %d: %q vs %q", len(got), len(want), got, want). Otherwise loop over the indexes, and at the first got[i] != want[i], return fmt.Sprintf("element %d: got %q, want %q", i, got[i], want[i]).
